Cash flow footnote (1): "Other income and expenses" for the half year ended June 30, 2023 mainly comprise an IFRS 2 impact of €0.9 million. Other income and expenses (Note 9, € thousand): IPO costs 0; Company acquisition costs (1,065); Other (289); total (1,354).
ng.definition: The Group defines EBITDA (adjusted) as operating profit, less (i) additions net of reversals to depreciation, amortization and impairment of non-current assets; (ii) non-recurring income and expenses as presented in the Group's consolidated income statement within "Other income" and "Other expenses", and (iii) the impact of items that do not reflect ordinary operating performance (in particular business reorganization and adaption costs, costs relating to acquisition and external growth transactions, as well as the IFRS 2 share-based payment expense). [Note 4] EBIT (adjusted): as defined in Section 7.4 of the 2023 Registration Document (excluding depreciation and amortization corresponding to purchase price allocations). [Key figures note 3 / section 3.6]

notes: Comparative column of the H1 2024 report (unaudited, not reviewed). € thousand converted to € million (3 decimals). SELF-CHECKS: IS recurring operating profit lines sum to 20,538 vs printed 20,537 and operating profit to 19,183 vs 19,184 (€1 thousand rounding, within tolerance); CF operating lines sum to 15,867 vs printed 15,866, investing to (22,814) vs (22,815), financing to (5,384) vs (5,383), and cfo+cfi+cff+fx = (12,406) vs printed (12,405) = 16,550 - 28,955 (all €1 thousand rounding). Segment adjusted gross margin 42.1 + 14.4 + 0.0 = 56.5 vs 56.6 (rounding). Balance-sheet checks not possible (no 30-June-2023 statement). EPS: ni/wsh = 8.307/30.387m = 0.27 does NOT equal the printed 0.10 because Note 12 deducts a preferential dividend attributable to A preferred shares of €5,260 thousand (net profit attributable to the Company 3,047; 3.047/30.387344m = 0.10, check passes). Note 12 footnote: basic and diluted EPS for the 2023 comparative were calculated taking into account ordinary shares and performance shares issued or cancelled in the first half of 2024 - i.e. the H1 2023 weighted share count (30,387,344) and EPS are presented on the post-reorganisation basis, not as originally existing in 2023. BRIDGE: top-down reconciliation only (34.0 - 11.1 - 1.4 - 2.4 = 19.1 vs OP 19.2, rounding); the split of 'Other' 2.4 into IFRS 2 and non-recurring items is not printed (the cash-flow footnote gives an IFRS 2 impact of €0.9 million). EBITDA and D&A ex-PPA not printed. Net profit: income statement 8,307; equity statement 8,306. Adjusted EBIT 27.2 (key figures and section 3.6 consistent). No balance sheet, net debt, employee count, capex split or outlook is published for H1 2023.
